pulls.title: feat(m3): differential comparison engine with fail-closed divergence …
pulls.body:
Implements M3 (SG-03). Replaces the `differential` stub in ci.yml with a real job that runs 12 tests.

## What landed

- contract-tests/differential/normalize.mjs — deterministic normalization. 11 documented transient keys are stripped; unknown keys are never transient.
- contract-tests/differential/run.mjs — recursive diff by JSON pointer. Reports TYPE, MISSING, EXTRA, LENGTH, VALUE divergences with exact paths.
- contract-tests/differential/run.test.mjs — 12 tests, all failure paths produce HELD.
- 5 fixtures — identical (modulo transient), value-diverged, missing-key, extra-key.

## Test result

12/12 pass locally. Node 26, `node --test contract-tests/differential/run.test.mjs`.

## Fail-closed

- Unknown keys never stripped — an extra key is a divergence, not a silence
- Missing files exit 3 with `[HELD] FILE_MISSING`
- No args exits 2 with usage
- `decide()` never returns ADMITTED when any divergence exists

Evidence class: Implementation evidence.

pulls.title: contract: establish versioned TWGT admission boundary
pulls.body: Establishes the canonical versioned twgt.admission 1.0.0 contract. Defines the terminal states ADMITTED, HELD, REJECTED and the current ReasonCode wire values. Consumers, including twgt-bridge, must validate against this artifact rather than redefine the enum. Unsupported contract versions must fail closed.

pulls.title: M2: schema registry + contract-test harness
pulls.body:
## M2 · SG-01 + SG-02

Implements the schema registry and contract-test harness for twgt-schema-gate.

### What landed

- schemas/registry.json plus 8 schema files under schemas/v1/
- contract-tests/registry-integrity/ — Node and Python parity checks
- contract-tests/fixtures/ — 16 fixtures (one valid + one invalid per schema)
- contract-tests/lib/jsonschema-mini.mjs — dependency-free validator
- .github/workflows/ci.yml — registry-integrity and schema-fixtures jobs implemented

### Evidence

- Local Node registry-integrity: PASS
- Local Python registry-integrity: PASS
- Local Node schema-fixtures: 16/16 PASS
- Branch head: e3e253a

### Expected CI result

- registry-integrity: green
- schema-fixtures: green
- differential, safety-gate, privacy, supply-chain, reproducibility: red — stubs by design, land in M3–M7

Evidence class: Implementation evidence (wiki.md §2.3)
